# The Returners

The Returners are a mutual-aid and research movement headquartered at Waystation. They seek a voluntary way home before living out their whole local lives. Many do not yet know what a natural return would mean. Their public hope is honest even when their leaders conceal facts.

V founded the network and supplies hard-earned expertise. Stern protects field teams; Marla keeps the refuge fed. Edda Rill organizes relief and presses for faster progress. She wants to rejoin her outside daughter and initially trusts unsafe assurances about the Glasshouse bypass. Evidence can change her mind. Some cells persist knowingly with mass-passage experiments; they do not represent every Returner.

Allies include local-born people who support freedom of choice while refusing to endanger their own families. A restored safe Door can serve willing Riftborn without transferring native-born people or erasing the local world. Public research custody, consent and continued containment are concrete political questions.

Campaign truth, V's concealed knowledge and the experiment's actual causes live in DM-SECRETS.md. After each act, update who knows what and who actually controls the records; do not reset the movement to its opening leadership after the party changes it.
